[[sn:Lambda Duties]][[sn:Lambda Duties]]Lambda duties are a series of duties required by [[Commandment Lambda Omega]].

They are secular duties in the sense that they are not ones that directly lead to [[ennoblement]] but rather maintain the church so ennoblement will be continuously possible
